wrongUnits.correct: Conditional on all UPDATEs succeeding. Update Agents and Update Agencies have errorRowDisposition=FailComponent (DTSX:5139, 5183). A failed UPDATE fails the data flow; rows already updated stay updated (no transaction), later rows are not written, and because 'Update agents balance' -> 'Set Gen_commissionpostponed' (disabled) -> 'update agents commissionpostponed field' are Success constraints (DTSX:7073-7074), the commission-postponed steps for agents and agencies do not run in that run.

wrongUnits.problem: Owner of unqualified gen_agentvalue / gen_agencyvalue assumed.
wrongUnits.correct: gen_agentvalue, gen_agencyvalue, gen_agencieid and gen_agentsid are unqualified in the source query (DTSX:5062-5090). The text treats them as the agent's and agency's stored values/keys (e.g. 'all no-agent rows of an agency group into one row', which needs gen_agentvalue to be NULL when there is no agent, i.e. owned by gen_agents) without stating the ambiguity reasoning (the UPDATEs prove Gen_agentsBase.gen_agentvalue and Gen_agencieBase.gen_agencyvalue/gen_agencieid exist; another joined table with the same column would make the query ambiguous and fail; per the user the package runs in production).

Units [1]-[7] verified. End unit [8] presents as certain that every selected agent is marked except one whose update returned a CRM error, and that such an error is logged as a warning.

wrongUnits.correct: Not proven by the files: (a) whether ExecuteMultipleExtension (external CRM.Proxy) sets ContinueOnError. If it does not, requests after the first faulted one in the same batch are not executed, get no response item, and stay unmarked with no warning, so 'only the agent with a CRM error stays unmarked' is not established (the package's own open question [3] says ContinueOnError is unknown). (b) The exception path: an exception from ExcecuteBulk called at the 1000th row is caught in Input0_ProcessInputRow, the current row goes to the unconnected CastingError output and myEntities is not cleared, so later batches are not sent until EndOfRowset; the final ExcecuteBulk at EndOfRowset is outside try/catch, so an exception there (including the ApplicationException for a missing response) fails the data flow, and the agencies step (Success constraint DTSX:7075) does not run. (c) Whether faults are reported at all depends on the external proxy types (cast of response.Results[1].Value to OrganizationResponseCollection).
